beginner.title: Get started with NVDA screen reader
beginner.outcome: You can: set up NVDA screen reader, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Turn it on and set it up
beginner.outcome: You can: start using NVDA screen reader
beginner.practice: Set up NVDA screen reader for your needs

beginner.title: Everyday tasks
beginner.outcome: You can: use NVDA screen reader for daily tasks
beginner.practice: Complete three daily tasks with NVDA screen reader

intermediate.title: Customise
intermediate.outcome: You can: tailor NVDA screen reader to you

intermediate.title: Work and study
intermediate.outcome: You can: use NVDA screen reader at work or school
intermediate.practice: Use NVDA screen reader in one meeting or class

intermediate.title: Signature skills in NVDA screen reader
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make NVDA screen reader distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced NVDA screen reader
expert.outcome: You can: use NVDA screen reader's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Support and advocate
expert.outcome: You can: help others and test accessibility
expert.practice: Test a document or website with NVDA screen reader

expert.title: Integrate NVDA screen reader into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect NVDA screen reader with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect NVDA screen reader to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use NVDA screen reader well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use NVDA screen reader" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
